description: IDA Wireless Simulator is provided by IDA-TUBS. IDA Wireless Simulator is an OMNeT++ library for lossy wireless networks and sample-based protocols, including DDS exchanges of large data objects. It specifies OMNeT++ 6 and INET 4.5 and requires an INET patch. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment.
